name: alt-e2e-playwright
description: Playwright E2E suites for every Alt microservice. One install root; each e2e/playwright/<service>/ is a suite with its own config, run.sh and specs.

scripts.list: for d in */; do [ -f "$d/playwright.config.ts" ] && (cd "$d" && npx playwright test --list >/dev/null && echo "ok $d"); done
